items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Unauthenticated Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution (Admin Privileges)
items.summary: This stored XSS vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security feature bypass and requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: This critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows unauthenticated PHP object injection via a crafted cookie, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento's REST API
items.summary: A critical flaw allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any Magento or Adobe Commerce store via the REST API, potentially leading to remote code execution or account takeover.
